x: Mark Davis's hurdling is coming on well. He set a pb of 11.84 and was close to the club record in the 80 metre hurdles in the Boys section of the SoEAA under 20 championships.
Left: With determination etched into his face, Mark Davis sets about another 100 metre hurdle field. Mark topped our 1993 under 17 sprint hurdle rankings and set Club Records in two multi-events.

The Intermediate Boys event saw Mark Davis get to within 57 points of the winner, placing 2nd in the competition with 3004 points and the following fine series of performances: HJ/1.65, 100mH/15.2, JT/40.80, SP/10.34, 800/2:26.9, LJ/5.74.
